findings.evidence: Step 1.2 extends the independence identity to every nonnegative Borel h and allows infinite expectations. If P(A)=0 and E[h(X)]=infinity, the asserted right side P(A)E[h(X)] is 0*infinity and is undefined. The lemma's subsequent use with h(t)=t+ and h(t)=t- is integrable because X is in L1, so its conclusion and this consumer's use remain justified. Repair the intermediate assertion by restricting to integrable h or splitting off P(A)=0 without using the undefined product.
